Container.Name: Cat-O-Fit
Container.Overview: Self-hosted training planner for the whole family: periodized plans for running, strength and team sport, load and form tracking, nutrition, body values and a shared dashboard. A web app (PWA) in seven languages that works offline on every device. No database and no subscription: all data stays as plain files in the appdata folder. Built for your own, trusted network. Before you make it reachable from the internet, put a login in front of it (see the advanced settings and the installation guide).
Container.Description:
Cat-O-Fit is training planning for the whole family. It creates periodized plans from 5 km to the marathon (and programmes without a race), manages training load with one daily coach recommendation, and brings in body values from Apple Health, Health Connect or activity files.
Strength and mobility sessions come with animated exercises you can follow along. Every person has their own goals and plan; cycle, lab values and supplements stay private, also on the server.
Open the web interface on your phone, tablet or computer and add it to the home screen. The first start walks you through a short setup (create the admin, start empty or with demo data).
The data lives as JSON files in the appdata folder: back it up like any other share. Documentation, update and backup guides: https://github.com/Bingerminger/cat-o-fit/tree/main/docs

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface. Change the host port if 8080 is already in use; the container always listens on 80.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: All data (people, plans, trainings, body values) as JSON files. Keep this path stable and include it in your backups.

Config.Name: Time zone (TZ)
Config.Description: Time zone for PHP and the times in the calendar files, for example Europe/Vienna or America/New_York. Invalid values fall back to Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Basic auth (CATOFIT_BASIC_AUTH)
Config.Description: Optional. Set to 1 to put a sign-in (basic auth) in front of the whole app; then user name and password below are required, otherwise the container refuses to start. Recommended if the app is reachable from outside your home network.

Config.Name: Basic auth user (CATOFIT_AUTH_USER)
Config.Description: Optional. User name for the basic auth sign-in. Only used when Basic auth is set to 1.

Config.Name: Basic auth password (CATOFIT_AUTH_PASSWORD)
Config.Description: Optional. Password for the basic auth sign-in; please use a long one. Only used when Basic auth is set to 1.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts (CATOFIT_ALLOWED_HOSTS)
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated host names the API accepts, for example fit.example.org (protection against DNS rebinding). Leave empty to accept all; if you set it, include every name or address you use to open the app.
